as_told.title: Nat Kobitz saw UFO technology at Wright-Patterson

plain: A man named Nat Kobitz was taken under heavy guard into a room beneath Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio and shown a piece of what he called a bulkhead, part of the wall of a craft, made of material bonded at the atomic level. The journalist Ross Coulthart tells Michels this is what Kobitz described to him in person. Michels later repeats it from Coulthart, saying that Kobitz was dying of cancer when he said he had seen UFO technology at the base, though in his version the bulkhead is left out. If it were true, it would mean the Air Force holds pieces of craft nobody on Earth knows how to make.
